checks.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "set -e
BASE=65f17e55ed3622cafcd603c925a98db9f55ff602
BASE_TREE=ceec2ea6ed2280dd97c964e62da7cf52e7b68940
CANDIDATE=f86d201372c405e43359c8fde8d0106f9c7401c0
CANDIDATE_TREE=16afc20436f98937c4d8481c0e23fa12a9578f12
PREDECESSOR=955b90e80a1a675d2bb7c014620ed0697d573450
printf 'origin/main: '; rtk git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main
printf 'origin/main tree: '; rtk git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main"'^{tree}
printf '"'candidate: '; rtk git rev-parse \""'$CANDIDATE"
printf '"'candidate tree: '; rtk git rev-parse \""'$CANDIDATE''^{tree}"
printf '"'base tree: '; rtk git rev-parse \""'$BASE''^{tree}"
printf '"'candidate parents: '; rtk git show -s --format='%P' \""'$CANDIDATE"
printf '"'R3 local branch: '; rtk git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/codex/nicegui-base-stable3-visualize-theme-native-audit-verify-3
printf 'base ancestor: '; if rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor \""'$BASE" "$CANDIDATE"; then echo true; else echo false; fi
printf '"'predecessor ancestor: '; if rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor \""'$PREDECESSOR" "$CANDIDATE"; then echo true; else echo false; fi
printf '"'base-to-candidate diff names:\\n'; rtk git diff --name-only \""'$BASE" "$CANDIDATE"
printf '"'candidate audit paths:\\n'; rtk git ls-tree -r --name-only \""'$CANDIDATE" .codex-fabric
printf '"'worktree porcelain:\\n'; rtk git status --porcelain=v1
printf 'checks:\\n'; test \""'$(rtk git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" = "$BASE"; test "$(rtk git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main''^{tree})" = "$BASE_TREE"; test "$(rtk git rev-parse "$CANDIDATE")" = "$CANDIDATE"; test "$(rtk git rev-parse "$CANDIDATE''^{tree}")" = "$CANDIDATE_TREE"; test "$(rtk git rev-parse "$BASE''^{tree}")" = "$BASE_TREE"; test "$(rtk git rev-parse refs/heads/codex/nicegui-base-stable3-visualize-theme-native-audit-verify-3)" = "$CANDIDATE"; rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" "$CANDIDATE"; rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor "$PREDECESSOR" "$CANDIDATE"; test -z "$(rtk git status --porcelain=v1)"; echo PASS'

/bin/zsh -lc "set -e
BASE=65f17e55ed3622cafcd603c925a98db9f55ff602
BASE_TREE=ceec2ea6ed2280dd97c964e62da7cf52e7b68940
CANDIDATE=f86d201372c405e43359c8fde8d0106f9c7401c0
CANDIDATE_TREE=16afc20436f98937c4d8481c0e23fa12a9578f12
PREDECESSOR=955b90e80a1a675d2bb7c014620ed0697d573450
BRANCH=codex/nicegui-base-stable3-visualize-theme-native-audit-verify-3
EXPECTED='source/nicegui_base/certification/mac_lab.py
source/nicegui_base/integrations/nicegui_visualization.py
source/nicegui_base/workbench/app.py
source/tests/test_chg163_visualization_theme.py'
LOCAL_HEAD="'$(rtk proxy git rev-parse "refs/heads/$BRANCH")
WORK_HEAD=$(rtk proxy git rev-parse HEAD)
ORIGIN_MAIN=$(rtk proxy git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)
ORIGIN_MAIN_TREE=$(rtk proxy git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main''^{tree})
CANDIDATE_TREE_OBSERVED=$(rtk proxy git rev-parse "$CANDIDATE''^{tree}")
BASE_TREE_OBSERVED=$(rtk proxy git rev-parse "$BASE''^{tree}")
DIFF_NAMES=$(rtk proxy git diff --name-only "$BASE" "$CANDIDATE")
set -- $(rtk proxy git ls-remote --heads origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH")
REMOTE_BRANCH_SHA=$1
REMOTE_BRANCH_REF=$2
set -- $(rtk proxy git ls-remote --heads origin refs/heads/main)
REMOTE_MAIN_SHA=$1
printf '"'local_head=%s\\n' \""'$LOCAL_HEAD"
printf '"'work_head=%s\\n' \""'$WORK_HEAD"
printf '"'remote_branch_sha=%s\\n' \""'$REMOTE_BRANCH_SHA"
printf '"'remote_branch_ref=%s\\n' \""'$REMOTE_BRANCH_REF"
printf '"'origin_main=%s\\n' \""'$ORIGIN_MAIN"
printf '"'remote_main_sha=%s\\n' \""'$REMOTE_MAIN_SHA"
printf '"'origin_main_tree=%s\\n' \""'$ORIGIN_MAIN_TREE"
printf '"'candidate_tree=%s\\n' \""'$CANDIDATE_TREE_OBSERVED"
printf '"'base_tree=%s\\n' \""'$BASE_TREE_OBSERVED"
printf '"'commit_distance=%s\\n' \""'$(rtk proxy git rev-list --count "$BASE..$CANDIDATE")"
printf '"'diff_names:\\n%s\\n' \""'$DIFF_NAMES"
printf '"'codex_fabric_candidate_paths:\\n%s\\n' \""'$(rtk proxy git ls-tree -r --name-only "$CANDIDATE" .codex-fabric)"

test "$LOCAL_HEAD" = "$CANDIDATE"
test "$WORK_HEAD" = "$CANDIDATE"
test "$REMOTE_BRANCH_SHA" = "$CANDIDATE"
test "$REMOTE_BRANCH_REF" = "refs/heads/$BRANCH"
test "$ORIGIN_MAIN" = "$BASE"
test "$REMOTE_MAIN_SHA" = "$BASE"
test "$ORIGIN_MAIN_TREE" = "$BASE_TREE"
test "$CANDIDATE_TREE_OBSERVED" = "$CANDIDATE_TREE"
test "$BASE_TREE_OBSERVED" = "$BASE_TREE"
test "$(rtk proxy git rev-list --count "$BASE..$CANDIDATE")" = 3
test "$DIFF_NAMES" = "$EXPECTED"
rtk proxy git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" "$CANDIDATE"
rtk proxy git merge-base --is-ancestor "$PREDECESSOR" "$CANDIDATE"
test -z "$(rtk proxy git status --porcelain=v1)"
rtk proxy git diff --quiet "$CANDIDATE" --
rtk proxy git diff --cached --quiet
printf '"'verification=PASS\\n'"

commits.subject: Fix visualization dark theme preservation on mount
